title: Feed rows: a room's messages and pending sends, grouped by author
spec: Implement feed_rows in crates/ui-model/src/feed.rs as its doc comment says: one FeedRow per Shown entry in order; Line becomes Message and Pending stays Pending with every field copied; first_of_group is true unless the row directly above is a Message by exactly the same author. Remove the clippy::todo allow. No new dependencies.
